en.summary: This commit fixes real LoopMatmul scheduling logic in generated hardware: the DMA max-block-length computation used a bits-versus-bytes conversion error, and the transposed load iterators were corrected so large-block mvins advance over the right row/column dimensions.
why_it_counts: The changed file is the LoopMatmul Chisel controller that generates DUT load scheduling logic.
The patch corrects arithmetic used to limit DMA block size and updates iterator progression in the transpose paths.
A wrong max-block-length or iterator walk changes which memory tiles are fetched and when, which is a DUT behavior bug.
disqualifiers: The commit also includes unrelated CI tuning in .circleci files.
evidence: LoopMatmul.scala changes max_block_len from dma_max_bytes / (block_size * input_w * 8) to dma_max_bytes / (block_size * input_w / 8).
The same fix is applied to max_block_len_acc, showing the original bug was a unit-conversion error.
LoopMatmulLdA and LoopMatmulLdB now advance row and column iterators through row_iterator/col_iterator instead of the old transpose-unaware next_i/next_k and next_j/next_k scheme.
LoopMatmulLdD changes iteration order to advance i by 1 and j by max_blocks, matching block stepping instead of the earlier swapped schedule.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The bug is a DMA tiling/scheduling arithmetic error. A matrix loader computes how many elements or blocks can fit into one DMA transfer, but the formula accidentally treats element width in bits as if it were already in bytes. That produces a block-length limit that is far too small, and in transpose-sensitive paths it also interacts with the wrong row/column iterator stepping. The loader then walks memory tiles in the wrong chunking pattern.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: DMA block-length limit and tiled iterator progression for matrix loads
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Loop-based matrix load paths choose transfer block sizes near the DMA maximum, especially for transposed or multi-block loads
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Restore the unit-conversion bug so the loader computes max transfer blocks using bit width instead of byte width, and optionally restore the old transpose iterator stepping.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: bits-versus-bytes arithmetic bug in tile scheduler
portability_notes: Map this to any loop controller that splits matrix moves into DMA-sized blocks.
The cleanest reusable bug is the unit-conversion error; transpose-step bugs are a closely related secondary slice.
Expect the fault to be most visible when blocks are large enough that the max-block-length limiter matters.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the formula that derives maximum transferable blocks or columns from DMA max bytes and element width.
Replace element-width-in-bytes with element-width-in-bits, or otherwise shrink the computed block limit by an 8x unit error.
If the design also supports transpose-aware iteration, keep the old row/column stepping so transposed multi-block loads walk the wrong dimension first.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LoopMatmul DMA block-size calculation and transpose-aware iterator update logic
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix corrects max_block_len/max_block_len_acc byte arithmetic and rewrites the LdA/LdB/LdD iterator updates so transposed large-block loads advance through the intended row/column counters.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the pre-fix max_block_len formulas using input_w * 8 / acc_w * 8, and if needed restore the earlier next_i/next_k and next_j/next_k transpose update logic in LoopMatmul.scala.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Loop-driven DMA loads fetch tiles in the wrong chunk sizes or wrong iteration order, leading to missed, repeated, or misaligned matrix data for large or transposed moves.
evidence_for_injection: The formula change is an unambiguous unit-conversion correction from bits to bytes.
Iterator updates were rewritten in the same commit specifically around transpose-aware row/column state.
The commit subject itself centers on max block length, which matches the core hardware mechanism changed in the file.
notes: For the most portable single edit, the max_block_len formula bug is cleaner than the transpose iterator slice.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了生成硬件中的真实 LoopMatmul 调度逻辑：DMA 最大 block 长度计算存在 bits/bytes 单位换算错误，而且针对大块转置 mvin 的 load 迭代器推进方式也被纠正为正确的行/列维度。
why_it_counts: 修改文件是生成 DUT load 调度逻辑的 LoopMatmul Chisel 控制器。
补丁修正了限制 DMA block 大小的算术公式，并更新了转置路径下的迭代器推进方式。
错误的 max-block-length 或迭代顺序会直接改变取回哪些内存 tile 以及取回时机，属于真实 DUT 行为缺陷。
disqualifiers: 该提交还包含与 DUT 无关的 .circleci 调整。
evidence: LoopMatmul.scala 把 max_block_len 从 dma_max_bytes / (block_size * input_w * 8) 改为 dma_max_bytes / (block_size * input_w / 8)。
max_block_len_acc 也做了同样修正，说明原始缺陷是单位换算错误。
LoopMatmulLdA 与 LoopMatmulLdB 现在通过 row_iterator/col_iterator 推进，而不是旧的、对 transpose 不敏感的 next_i/next_k 与 next_j/next_k。
LoopMatmulLdD 改为 i 按 1 递增、j 按 max_blocks 递增，匹配块步进，而不是早先的错误顺序。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该缺陷属于 DMA 分块/调度算术错误。矩阵加载器需要计算一次 DMA 传输能容纳多少元素或 block，但旧公式把元素位宽当成了字节宽度，得到的 block 长度上限过小；在支持 transpose 的路径里，这又会和错误的行/列迭代推进方式叠加，导致内存 tile 被按错误块大小和错误顺序遍历。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 矩阵加载中的 DMA block 长度上限与 tile 迭代推进
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 基于 loop 的矩阵 load 路径需要按 DMA 最大字节数拆分 block，尤其在 transpose 或多 block load 时
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 恢复单位换算错误，让加载器用位宽而不是字节宽度去计算 max transfer blocks；必要时再恢复旧的 transpose 迭代推进方式。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: tile 调度器中的 bits-versus-bytes 算术错误
portability_notes: 把该缺陷映射到任何把矩阵搬运拆成 DMA 大小块的 loop controller。
最干净、最可复用的缺陷切片是单位换算错误；transpose 步进错误是相关的次级切片。
当 block 足够大、确实需要触发 max-block-length 限制时，缺陷最容易显现。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位根据 DMA 最大字节数和元素宽度推导可传输 block/列数的公式。
把元素宽度的“字节”重新替换成“位”，或用等效的 8 倍单位错误去缩小计算出的 block 上限。
如果设计支持 transpose 迭代，则保留旧的行/列推进方式，使转置多 block load 先沿错误维度遍历。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LoopMatmul 的 DMA block 大小计算与 transpose 感知迭代更新逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复纠正了 max_block_len/max_block_len_acc 的字节算术，并重写了 LdA/LdB/LdD 的迭代更新，使转置大块 load 能沿正确的行/列计数器前进。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复 LoopMatmul.scala 中修复前的 max_block_len 公式（使用 input_w * 8 / acc_w * 8），必要时也恢复旧的 next_i/next_k 与 next_j/next_k 转置更新逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Loop 驱动的 DMA load 会以错误块大小或错误迭代顺序抓取 tile，导致大块或转置搬运时出现遗漏、重复或错位的矩阵数据。
evidence_for_injection: 公式修改是非常明确的 bits 到 bytes 单位修正。
同一提交还重写了与 transpose 相关的迭代更新。
提交标题本身就聚焦于 max block len，与文件中修正的核心硬件机制一致。
notes: 如果只保留一个最可复用的单点注入，max_block_len 公式错误比 transpose 迭代切片更干净。
